none: PAS NLM-216C16: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Virtus Exercit issue of 320-321, Reece period 16, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONS[---]TINV[--]. Reverse description: Trophy with bound captive either side. Reverse inscription: VIRTVS EXERCIT. In exergue: probably PTR. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.9mm, Weight: 2.54gms, die axis: 6
